candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `MinSum = _val;` so SetMinSum no longer updates MinSum.
Delete the guard `if(intitalized)revert();` so SetMinSum can still update MinSum even after initialization, whereas the original would revert and leave MinSum unchanged.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = _val + 1;` so the stored MinSum differs from the value passed in.
Delete the guard statement 'if(intitalized)revert();' so SetMinSum can overwrite MinSum even after initialization.
Delete the assignment 'MinSum = _val;' so SetMinSum no longer changes MinSum.
Replace 'if(intitalized)revert();' with its negation 'if(!intitalized)revert();' so SetMinSum only works after initialization.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = 0;' so SetMinSum always sets MinSum to zero instead of _val.
Delete the statement `LogFile = Log(_log);` so the LogFile address is never set (stays address(0)), causing later Put calls that use LogFile to behave differently.
Delete the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard so SetLogFile can still change the LogFile address after initialization, altering which log contract receives subsequent AddMessage calls.
Delete the statement `acc.balance += msg.value;` so the deposited balance is never recorded.
Replace the unlockTime assignment with `acc.unlockTime=block.timestamp;` so lock times no longer extend into the future.
Change the condition guarding the unlockTime update to `acc.unlockTime>block.timestamp+_lockTime`, inverting which callers get their lock time extended.
Change the logged value to `acc.balance` instead of `msg.value` so the Log history records a different amount after each Put.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so no History entry is appended to the Log contract on Put.
